name: Roleplayer's Quill
description: A book editor for people who write in Minecraft. Select a passage and set it bold, coloured, underlined, or aligned left, centre, right or justified – laid out to the pixel with the game's own spaces, so the finished book reads the same for everyone, with no mod and no resource pack. Paste a chapter in and it flows across as many pages as it needs, hyphenated by the rules of Russian or English if you want the lines full. Lists, tables, a character browser, a format brush, import and export to a file, and voice typing that runs offline on your own machine. Replaces the sign, anvil and chat editors too. Client side only.
